A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Wookiee''' was trained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. During the [[Swarm War]] the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] individual was training to become a Jedi at the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Ossus Academy]]. When [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]] visited the academy, the apprentice was partaking in a game of [[Skorch]].
